eligibility: Connected 3D input with native fixed fragments and replaceable scaffold, plus fixed internal bond adjacent to an attachment. Input-only selection, no output filtering.
endpoint_policy: Report native validity/connectivity/fixed-substructure endpoint separately from mapped fixed chemistry, PoseBusters, scaffold novelty and strict-boundary diagnostics. No reference-identical new scaffold requirement.

future_intervention_protocol.pair_selection: All fixed-internal reference bonds adjacent to an attachment, from preprocessed INPUT and verified mapping. Each pair separately; not selected using generated outcomes.
future_intervention_protocol.operation: Restore one feedback pair relative vector to its fixed input vector, preserve centroid. One modification then native free rollout. No weights/main state/bond edits.
future_intervention_protocol.random_control: Equal realized coordinate-displacement norm; centroid preserved; direction orthogonal to targeted displacement; private random stream.
future_intervention_protocol.controls: Exact full-trajectory sham; matched seed, noise, source, weights and reconstruction. Keep passing baselines as adverse-effect controls.
future_intervention_protocol.conclusions: Separate outcomes; no unique-root-cause assertion. Group by ligand input; seeds/time points/control rollouts are not independent complexes.
future_intervention_protocol.stopping: Do not scan new times/modules/donors/strength per result. Keep absent matching failures and inconclusive tests as outcomes.
